title: After Starting as a Content Creator
description:
Two months since you started posting content.
You'd been consistent but the response had been small.
Today your follower count hit 100 for the first time.

choices.result_text:
100 people.
The number looked small — but it had been zero when you started.

It felt slow.
But 100 in two months — wasn't actually bad.

title: After Monetizing
description:
Two months since your content first became eligible for revenue.
The first earnings had come in.
The amount was small — but it felt different.

choices.result_text:
A small amount.
But it was the first money earned from content.

You thought about growing it.
That might be right.

title: After Something Went Viral
description:
Two months since a piece of content spread widely.
Followers had jumped sharply.
Today the momentum had settled.

choices.result_text:
The heat had cooled.
Viral is a moment — what comes after is skill.

You tried to aim for it.
Viral doesn't come from aiming.

title: After Starting to Freelance
description:
Two months since you went independent.
Work had been uneven.
Today the first steady client reached out.

choices.result_text:
You signed.
The first hard part of freelancing — is getting through the uneven stretch.

You looked at the terms first.
They were fine.
You signed.

title: After Getting into ETF Research
description:
Two months since you started studying ETF investing.
The concepts had felt foreign at first.
Today for the first time you felt like you could make a judgment on your own.

choices.result_text:
You decided to go in.
The studying had made the judgment possible.

You decided to keep studying.
Feeling like you could judge — might be the middle, not the end.

title: After Starting ETF Investments
description:
Three months since you started putting money into ETFs.
You'd been consistent.
Today you checked the return for the first time.

choices.result_text:
In the green.
A small gain — but the direction was right.

choices.text: Stay in even if it's negative
choices.result_text:
In the red.
But you didn't stop.
ETFs are built by time, not timing.

title: After Buying the Inside Information
description:
Two months since you paid for insider information.
You'd made a decision based on it.
Today the outcome came in.

choices.result_text:
It was right.
But information you paid for — could have legal exposure.

It was wrong.
Money lost, and the information was bad.

title: After Reporting the Suspicious Information
description:
Two months since you reported the suspicious insider tip.
Things had been quiet since.
Today the result came in.

choices.result_text:
It was handled.
Reporting hadn't been the easy choice.

choices.text: Had wondered if it was worth the trouble
choices.result_text:
You'd worried about it.
But the result came in.
It resolved in the right direction.

title: After Opening the Mystery USB
description:
Two months since you opened the unknown USB drive.
What was on it had stayed in your mind.
Today something connected to its contents surfaced.

choices.result_text:
Because you knew — you saw this differently.
Opening the USB had given you information.

You wished you hadn't opened it.
Knowing isn't always lighter.

title: After Your Credit Was Damaged
description:
Three months since the credit damage.
Recovery was underway.
Today you checked for the first time whether a loan was possible.

choices.result_text:
Not yet.
Expected — but confirming it felt heavy.

Recovery was underway.
Slowly.

title: After Drawing a Line on Credit
description:
Two months since you decided not to take it anymore and drew a line on the credit issue.
Today you checked how things had gone since.

choices.result_text:
It worked.
Drawing a line — is telling the other side where you stand.

They ignored it.
Drawing a line doesn't change the situation on its own.

title: After a FOMO Investment
description:
Two months since you got swept up in the atmosphere and invested.
You'd seen how it turned out.
Now a similar wave was building.

choices.result_text:
You held back.
The last FOMO investment had taught you.

You went in again.
'This time is different' — that was what you'd thought last time.

title: After Helping a Stranger
description:
Two months since you helped someone you had no connection to.
You'd mostly forgotten about it.
Today you ran into that person again somewhere unexpected.

choices.result_text:
You said hello.
They still remembered.

They remembered.
Someone whose name you hadn't known — had turned into a connection.

title: After Getting Promoted the Right Way
description:
Two months since you were promoted on the strength of your performance.
You'd been settling into the role.
Today a junior colleague came asking for advice.

choices.result_text:
You were straight with them.
The promotion had made this conversation possible.

You shared how you'd done it.
Having gotten there the orthodox way — means the method can be repeated.

title: After Earning the Certification
description:
Three months since you got the certification.
You'd been waiting for a chance to actually use it.
Today you found a listing that had it as a requirement.

choices.result_text:
You applied.
The certification had opened a door.

choices.text: Check that you meet the other requirements first
choices.result_text:
You checked the rest of the requirements.
You qualified.
You applied.
